text:
maria: Heads-up — urgent hotfix needed for eu-west1 embeddings 503 spike. Requesting expedited approval and pin. Image: `gcr.io/redwood/serving:embed-503-fix-20260321`. Change window: 10m. Can we approve for a rapid canary in the next 15m?

deploybot: Deploy request queued by maria. Canary plan: 2% for 5m -> 25% for 10m -> 100%. Rollback triggers: embed_503_rate delta > 1% or p95 latency +100ms. Required approvers: oncall, infra lead. CI: all checks green.

liam: Oncall here — I can monitor. +1 to expedited pin if infra signs off.

cheng: Quick check — does this touch model weights or just serving logic?

maria: Only serving logic / kvcache guard. No model artifacts changed. Safe to expedite from my side.

katie: Draft release-note snippet: `Fix: intermittent embeddings 503 on cache miss in eu-west1. Rollout: staged canary -> full. Pinned to v2026-03-21-hotfix-12.`

devon: Infra ok to proceed, watching capacity. I'll throttle ramp if we see CPU pressure. +1.

opsbot: Reminder: post-deploy runbook — metrics to watch: `embed_503_rate`, `embed_request_p95`, `kvcache_miss_rate`. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/embed-503.

maria: Pin name for rollout: `v2026-03-21-hotfix-12`. Starting canary now. deploybot, kick when ready.

deploybot: Deploy started by maria. Canary 2% initiated. Logs: https://deploy/logs/1788881234.

liam: Observing canary at 2% — embed_503_rate already down ~0.8%. Will report back in 5m.

cheng: Seeing a small p95 bump (~+10ms) but within SLO. No errors.

liam: Canary looks stable. Ramp to 25% please.

deploybot: Ramp to 25% in progress... complete.

devon: Infra metrics look fine, no signs of queue buildup. Proceed to 100%.

deploybot: Final ramp to 100% started -> complete. Rollout succeeded. Version pinned: v2026-03-21-hotfix-12 (eu-west1). Notifications dispatched.

katie: Final release note: "Hotfix: fixed intermittent 503s for embeddings in eu-west1. Deployed 2026-03-21 and pinned to v2026-03-21-hotfix-12. Monitoring in place; rollback criteria defined."

maria: Thanks all. If we see regressions open #incidents-eu and tag me. Closing thread. :tada:
